messages:
Mia Chen: Heads up — I'm going to cut branch release/1.10 at 17:00 PT today. Final merge cutoff 16:30 PT. Please post any post-cutoff backport requests in this thread.

Alex Rivera: Quick Q: are low-risk infra/ops fixes still allowed after cutoff? e.g. <https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/3421|#3421>

Mia Chen: No new features after cutoff. Low-risk bugfixes ok if:
- approved by a release owner
- have a changelog entry
Post a short cherry-pick request with the commit sha and target branch.

Samir Patel: I have a perf-regression fix (PR 3450) touching the runtime. Non-breaking but touches kernels. Who should approve backport?

Mia Chen: @Samir Patel, @Alex Rivera — you two coordinate. Release owners will review backports. Also ensure tests pass on the cherry-pick.

Alex Rivera: If you need the commands:
```
git checkout -b release/1.10 origin/main
git cherry-pick <commit-sha>
# resolve conflicts, run ./scripts/test-smoke.sh
```
And add label `backport-request` to the PR.

Jules (release-bot): Automated: release branch created: `release/1.10` by @Mia Chen at 2024-03-15T17:00:00Z

Samir Patel: I'll take #3450. Picking commit `abc1234`. Will open PR and link here.

Alex Rivera: If cherry-pick conflicts, ping #eng-runtime oncall or tag me. Also update PR body with `cherry-pick-to: release/1.10` and add the one-line changelog under Unreleased -> 1.10.

Mia Chen: Thanks all — final reminder 30min until cutoff :alarm_clock:

Samir Patel: Got it, opening PR now — will post the link.

Alex Rivera: :thumbsup:
